name: Fly
origin: granted the power of effortless flight

name: Invisibility
origin: able to vanish from sight at will

traits.name: Invisibility
entries: The creature can turn invisible until it attacks or casts a spell. It can use this ability once per short or long rest.

name: Regeneration
origin: capable of rapidly healing its wounds

traits.name: Regeneration
entries: The creature regains 3 hit points at the start of its turn. If the creature takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn.

name: Charm Aura
origin: surrounded by an aura that bends emotions

traits.name: Charm Aura
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the creature must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of its next turn.

name: Fear Aura
origin: radiating a chilling aura of fear

traits.name: Fear Aura
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the creature must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of its next turn.

name: Explosive Death
origin: known to violently erupt upon death

traits.name: Explosive Death
entries: When the creature dies, it explodes. Each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

name: Shapechanger
origin: gifted with the ability to take many forms

traits.name: Shapechanger
entries: The creature can use its action to polymorph into a Beast of CR 1/4 or lower, or back into its true form. Its statistics remain the same in each form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The creature has advantage on saving throws against cantrips.

name: Poisonous Bite
origin: armed with a dangerously venomous bite

actions.name: Poisonous Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

name: Stone Skin
origin: protected by skin as hard as stone

traits.name: Stone Skin
entries: The creature's rocky hide grants it resistance to slashing damage.

name: Mind Control
origin: capable of bending weaker minds to its will

traits.name: Mind Control
entries: The creature targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Explosive Speed
origin: able to move with sudden, explosive bursts

traits.name: Explosive Speed
entries: The creature can Dash as a bonus action.

name: Summons Minions
origin: able to call lesser creatures to its aid

traits.name: Summon Minions
entries: Once per day, the creature can summon one creature of CR 1/4 or lower. The summoned creature appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the creature and acts immediately after its turn. It remains for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 hit points.

name: Cursed Touch
origin: carrying a touch that inflicts lingering curses

traits.name: Cursed Touch
entries: When the creature hits a target with a melee attack, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be cursed for 1 minute. While cursed, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
